text:
incident-bot: Paging: latency-surge detected for model-routes serving fp8-calibrated variants. p99 crossing SLO. auto-escalation -> incidents channel.

pager-julie: saw alerts around 02:45 UTC — p95 ~420ms -> 890ms, p99 spiking to 2.3s. Streaming stall counts +120% since 02:40. Noted higher error budgets for a few high-traffic customers.

sre-amy: confirming. dashboards show correlated increase in KV cache misses and GPU queue depth. Many requests falling back to host dequant path.

eng-ml-raj: rolling fp8 calibration to prod earlier today; telemetry indicated a subtle quant noise increase for long-context tokens. Could explain kv-dequant thrash.

oncall-lead: action: 1) immediate mitigation: route traffic for affected model-route to fp16 stable variant. 2) throttle streaming concurrency for lower-tier to shed tail. 3) open hotline for impacted customers. Assign owners.

sre-amy: starting traffic reroute now. applying policy: route model-route:*/customer-critical -> fp16-verified; others -> fp8 with reduced concurrency.

incident-bot: deploybot: started rollout of traffic-switch at 02:53 UTC.

support-luis: I've messaged top 3 high-traffic accounts and opened customer thread. CS Zoe joining to coordinate messages.

cs-zoe: ping — customers A & B reported visible stalls in streaming (progress bars freezing), some timed out clients. collecting logs and examples. will send summary in 15m.

eng-ml-raj: quick diagnostic: running a small replay with long-context prompts reproduces p99 tail with fp8-calib-enabled. trace shows dequant stall at KV restore path where dequant + attention rewrite hit unexpected memory access pattern causing scheduling jitter. suspect calibration table produced outlier scale for a small set of layers.

sre-amy: for triage: disable fp8-calib table for the problematic model id and fall back to per-layer int8-like profile? we need a safe fast rollback.

oncall-lead: prioritize low-risk path: 1) route to fp16 for critical customers (in flight). 2) hotfix to revert to previous calibration snapshot for fp8 on the model variant (owner: eng-ml-raj). 3) adjust autoscaling buffer + increase per-GPU worker threads to drain queue.

eng-ml-raj: starting revert to calib-snapshot v2026-03-10-12:30. will monitor.

incident-bot: telemetry: traffic-switch completed at 02:57 UTC, revert job started at 03:01 UTC.

pager-julie: after traffic switch, p99 dropped to ~720ms within 3m for routed customers, streaming stalls down ~60% for those routes. Global p99 still ~1.1s due to backlog draining.

support-luis: receiving fewer incoming CS tickets after 03:05 UTC, but some timed-out webhooks retried and created duplicate downstream events — CS to reconcile.

cs-zoe: customer-facing note drafted: short incident summary + immediate mitigations + ETA for full fix. requesting approval to send interim message.

oncall-lead: approve. keep wording: we are prioritizing stability, no user data exposure, will follow up with RCA.

eng-ml-raj: revert applied to canary at 03:07 UTC, promoting to all affected shards at 03:12 UTC. verifying model hash and calibration table checksum.

sre-amy: added temporary autoscaler bump + increased max concurrency for routing pool to reduce tail queuing during drain.

incident-bot: monitors: p95 back under SLO by 03:18 UTC; p99 under SLO for critical routes by 03:22 UTC. Global p99 cleared at 03:28 UTC.

pager-julie: paging: resolving active page at 03:30 UTC. marking "live-mitigation applied, root cause suspected calibration outlier in fp8 rollout".

eng-ml-raj: root-cause hypothesis: fp8 calibration run produced an outlier scale factor for two attention layers in the long-context path; when served at high concurrency, memory access pattern caused dequant overhead and GPU scheduling jitter — magnified in streaming where KV restore is hot. Repro on staging confirmed.

noncall-lead: immediate next steps (action items):
- eng-ml-raj: write postmortem draft (RCA, reproduction, dataset for calibration run) — due EOD today.
- eng-runtime (owner: sre-amy): add defensive fallback to detect calibration outliers at load time and switch to safe profile automatically.
- product/support (owner: cs-zoe & support-luis): customer comms and ticket reconciliation.
- infra: add a canary gating check for calibration runs (automated perf diff on p95/p99) before rollout.

cs-zoe: sending interim note now. will follow with targeted update once we have the postmortem.

incident-bot: summary created and attached to ticket INC-2026-3281. page resolved at 03:30 UTC.

pager-julie: TL;DR: fp8 calibration rollout caused intermittent tail spikes; routing rollback and revert of calibration snapshot mitigated; customers restored. Postmortem + preventative checklist assigned.

eng-ml-raj: will include small synthetic harness and config diff in postmortem so calibration job fails fast on outlier scales.

sre-amy: note for ops: consider temporary longer KV cache TTLs for streaming to reduce cold hits during a rollout window.

support-luis: closing opened CS tickets where resolved, leaving open ones for manual reconciliation.

cs-zoe: will share incident timeline + customer-impact table with Sales and Legal.

incident-bot: Incident closed. If further regressions occur, new page will be auto-raised.
